title: Motive
tagline: Car culture as content — auctions told as stories, not listings.
blurb: Curated collections, a structured car archive, and a garage of your own.
desc: Auction platforms treat cars as inventory. Motive treats them as stories — each car a page with provenance, photography, and the context that makes it matter to the culture around it.
Built as a Next.js platform with curated collections, a typed car archive, and 'the garage' — a personal space for the cars you follow and the ones you've owned.

commits.msg: Theme system + garage scaffold; collections wired to seed data
Scaffold: app pages, car types, 4 seed cars, 4 collections
